findings.title: Pages are heavy before any media is counted
findings.evidence: Median HTML document is 738 KB with 26 external scripts and 16 render-blocking scripts per page, across 5 pages. (HTML and resource counts only; images and fonts are additional.)
findings.mechanism: Cited traffic skews mobile and impatient — the visitor did not choose this site, an assistant suggested it. Every second before the answer appears is spent on a page they have no prior commitment to.

suggested_action.summary: Cut third-party scripts to the ones with a named owner and a measured purpose, defer everything non-critical, and split oversized HTML documents.
suggested_action.detail: Audit tag-manager containers first; they are usually where script count grows without anyone deciding it should.
suggested_action.verification: Re-measure document size and script count after the cull.

findings.title: Several render-blocking scripts sit in the document head
findings.evidence: Median of 16 scripts per page load synchronously without async or defer.
findings.mechanism: Each synchronous script pauses parsing, so the visitor stares at a blank screen while code they did not ask for downloads and executes.

suggested_action.summary: Add defer (or async where order does not matter) to every script that is not needed for first paint.

findings.title: Basic accessibility attributes are missing
findings.evidence: 4 form field(s) have no label, aria-label or id to bind a label to (across 5 crawled pages).
findings.mechanism: These attributes are what both assistive technology and text extractors rely on to know what an element is. Missing them excludes real users and leaves machine readers guessing at the same time.

suggested_action.summary: Fix the mechanical basics: a lang attribute on <html>, a bound label for every form field, and text or an aria-label on every link.
suggested_action.detail: This is a floor, not an accessibility audit: passing these checks does not make the site conformant, but failing them guarantees it is not.

not_applicable.reason: interior pages carry breadcrumbs or name the brand up front
